FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF APPLIED MANAGEMENT SCIENCES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH-160014.
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF RESEARCH ASSISTANT
Project: Endangered Wooden Architecture Program - "Documentation of the Wooden
Heritage of Shimla built during the 19th century”
Sponsoring Agency: Oxford Brookes University, UK
Designation: Research Assistant (01)
Position 1: Research Assistant (01)
Applicants are required to have completed Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in
Architecture with 60% marks or Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering with proven
experience in surveying with 60% marks. Preference will be given to the candidates
having experience in Architectural drawings, Conservation, Surveying, photography,
report writing. A strong understanding of research methodology is essential for this
role.
Honorarium: Rs. 25000 per month (Fixed) for Bachelor’s Degree Holder and Rs.
35,700/ per month (Fixed) for Master Degree Holder.
Duration: One Year or as per the duration of the project whichever is early. It may be
terminated even before (with one week notice if the work is not found satisfactory).
Documentation location: Shimla (Himachal Pradesh)for documentation and Panjab
University Chandigarh for research writing.
How to apply: Applications on plain paper giving following details must reach the
undersigned by January 22, 2025. A letter of interest along with CV and portfolio for the
application should be sent as a single PDF to ewap@pu.ac.in. Hard copy can be brought
at the time of interview, in case application is sent through email.
(Monika Aggarwal)
Professor and PU-facilitator of the Project
University Institute of Applied Management Sciences
